# My Halo Auto

> My Halo Auto is a mobile auto maintenance and repair service for personal and fleet vehicles in Washington DC, Maryland and Virginia (the DMV). An ASE-certified technician with 5+ years of experience performs the work at the customer's location (home, office, lot, yard or job site) where there is adequate, safe workspace. My Halo Auto specializes in maintenance and repair, not performance enhancement.

## Key facts

- Business: My Halo Auto
- Type: Mobile auto maintenance and repair (we come to you)
- Certification: ASE certified
- Experience: 5+ years
- Vehicles: Personal and fleet/company vehicles, all makes and models (domestic, import, European)
- Fleet vehicles: company and fleet vehicles such as work vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs; service on-site at your lot, yard or job site where there is adequate, safe workspace; the same service catalog as personal vehicles; scheduling arranged with your fleet manager; a single ASE-certified point of contact; an itemized invoice for each vehicle
- Service area: Washington DC, Maryland, Virginia
- Hours: Mon–Sat 7AM–7PM; Sunday by request
- Response: Typically within 12 hours during business hours
- Quotes: call, text or use the website form with the vehicle's year, make and model and a description of the issue; transparent quote, no hidden fees
- Standards: every fastener torqued to manufacturer specification; OEM repair procedures
- Google rating: 5.0 from 6 Google reviews
- Phone: (571) 969-4256
- Email: myhaloauto@gmail.com

## Not offered / by consultation

- Not offered: painting, bodywork, performance upgrades, coilover installation
- By consultation: engine swaps (not a mobile service; require adequate workspace, proper equipment and a suitable location), exhaust and custom fabrication
- Mobile service requires adequate workspace and a suitable area to work safely, such as a flat driveway, parking lot or garage.

## Pages

- [Home](https://myhaloauto.com/): ASE-certified mobile mechanic for personal and fleet vehicles in DC, Maryland and Virginia; reviews, service area, FAQ and quote form
- [Fleet Services](https://myhaloauto.com/fleet-services/): on-site maintenance and repair for company vans, pickups, sedans and SUVs, scheduled with your fleet manager, itemized invoice per vehicle
- [All Services](https://myhaloauto.com/services/): the full mobile service catalog, plus engine swaps (by consultation, not mobile) and what is not offered
- [Engine Repair & Diagnostics](https://myhaloauto.com/services/engine-repair/): full engine diagnostics, timing belt/chain replacement, head gasket repair, oil leak diagnosis and repair
- [Brake Service](https://myhaloauto.com/services/brake-repair/): brake pad and rotor replacement, caliper service and rebuild, brake line repair, hub and bearing replacement
- [Transmission & Clutch](https://myhaloauto.com/services/transmission-clutch/): transmission rebuild and replace, clutch replacement, flywheel replacement, fluid flush and service
- [Electrical & Diagnostics](https://myhaloauto.com/services/electrical-diagnostics/): OBD-II code diagnostics, wiring harness repair, alternator and starter service, sensor replacement
- [Cooling & Radiator Service](https://myhaloauto.com/services/cooling-system/): radiator replacement, water pump service, thermostat replacement, coolant flush and fill
- [Gaskets & Seals](https://myhaloauto.com/services/gaskets-seals/): timing cover gasket, valve cover gasket, intake manifold gasket, rear main seal replacement
- [Suspension & Steering](https://myhaloauto.com/services/suspension-steering/): strut and shock replacement, control arm and ball joint, tie rod replacement, power steering repair
- [General Maintenance](https://myhaloauto.com/services/maintenance/): oil change and filter, spark plug replacement, coolant and fluid flush, belt and hose replacement
- [Engine Swaps](https://myhaloauto.com/services/#engine-swaps): by consultation only; not a mobile service
